subject: Important Update: New Payment Method
body: Dear valued customer, we are excited to announce that we have introduced a new payment method to make your transactions more convenient. You can now securely pay using your credit card directly on our website. This change aims to streamline the payment process and provide you with a smoother experience. If you encounter any issues or have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services.
